claims.claim: The witness distinguishes an attempt, a produced body, a surface replacement and a later-request delivery in seven contract scenarios, including the cases where a bundle is durable but the surface is unchanged.
claims.harness: 30 assertions over real FileBundleStore files and synthetic event logs
claims.limitation: Synthetic events and a real bundle store; it says nothing about model behaviour.

claims.claim: Across 290 archived cells the witness finds 753 attempts, 673 committed, 62 refused, 6 aborted and 12 unverifiable; 12 cells had a legacy fold count higher than the committed count.
claims.harness: offline reconstruction from reports, raw requests, full messages and bundle directories
claims.limitation: Archived failures link an orphan bundle to an attempt by order (inferred); Basic has no EF bundle and no per-attempt delivery evidence.

claims.claim: The 42 E1 attempts split into 11 committed and 31 refused; every refusal reached the shrink check, every rationale call finished with a non-empty body, and no provider or bundle error appears.
claims.harness: per-attempt join of report errors, auxiliary calls and verified orphan bundles
claims.limitation: The E1 arm ran leafAdmission legacy; this is not the shipped tier configuration.

claims.claim: The state-only checkpoint body is 12 estimated tokens in every failed E1 attempt while the span is 58-207 tokens, so a pre-call shrink guard is not justified; retry suppression is also not justified because two retried cells committed after folding a ~9.2k-token span.
claims.harness: state-only rendering from the verified orphan bodies; retry spans from the committed bundles
claims.limitation: The archived failed attempts do not retain their span seqs, so a same-span refusal cache cannot be tested on this data. The economic-admission mismatch is a hypothesis, not a measured fix.

claims.claim: The 120-cell E1 arm ran with leafAdmission legacy because the E2E host does not pass that key, while all three shipped tiers set leafAdmission economic; the arm is therefore not the shipped economy tier.
claims.harness: source/default audit plus the frozen host config
claims.limitation: The audit proves the config difference. It does not measure what economic admission would have done on these cells.

claims.claim: The legacy 44/120 prompt-loss number is reproduced, but only 2/120 cells end with neither the task text nor the task values; 5 carry the request text in a checkpoint copy and 38 carry the task values without the wording.
claims.harness: per-primary-request digest matrix; 194 cells with full messages, 96 preview-only for prefix checks
claims.limitation: Values-only proves the task facts survived, not that the instruction wording or its constraints did.

claims.claim: The two E1 cells whose exact task message was lost still carried the task values in a checkpoint; their 0/2 pass rate is not explained by information absence.
claims.harness: exact digest and value probes in the last primary request
claims.limitation: n=2; a description, not an effect.

claims.claim: The confirm reproduces E1 18/24, with 11 committed-and-delivered cells (9 pass) and 13 no-fold cells (9 pass); all eight T2/T4 E1 cells committed, delivered a checkpoint carrying both probes, and passed.
claims.harness: ITT plus witness and delivery joins; exact McNemar reproduction
claims.limitation: The committed/no-fold split is descriptive, not randomized. One model, route and machine; no product claim.

claims.claim: The cost ledger reconciles with the campaign budget; E1 spent 7,083 input and 7,890 output tokens on 31 undelivered calls (47.2% of its output), of which 16 repeated calls cost 3,510 and 4,241.
claims.harness: per-cell report usage and per-attempt auxiliary usage
claims.limitation: Observed costs, not a counterfactual; no verifiable USD price is recorded.

claims.claim: The mixed-origin attack that the old inputs allowed is refused after the fix: the newest decision-capable citation determines the origin, and AnchorService.declare derives the producer and refuses a disagreeing label before the append.
claims.harness: real validator/planner plus the v2 anchor service; 12 regression tests
claims.limitation: The rule is conservative: a user decision that cites a newer assistant restatement is refused rather than reclassified.

claims.claim: The post-R1 evidence is preserved incrementally: 50 valid new cells plus 8 invalid negative-evidence cells in 787 files, verified on two local volumes with a verified git bundle and zero credentials.
claims.harness: copy + SHA256SUMS + bundle verify + credential scan
claims.limitation: The second copy is another local volume, not an off-machine backup.

claims.claim: A 72-cell B0/E0/E1 design is frozen with 12 offline-certified new instances, a 36/36 zero-request preflight, the corrected economic-admission config, and executionAuthorized false.
claims.harness: offline task certification + scripted zero-request preflight
claims.limitation: The preflight is a wiring test, not model behaviour. No live call is authorized; the envelope is a proposal.

claims.claim: The EF-R2 tarball installs and mounts basic/economy/quality with semantic continuity off; 13/13 smoke checks pass and the package contains no raw run, credential or checkout path.
claims.harness: installed-tarball smoke against a throwaway host
claims.limitation: Construction and composition only; no provider request. The local pack reports the rc7 preset drift because the installed DSH differs from the pinned CI reference.

note: The EF-R1 registry is unchanged. This file adds the EF-R2 claims; a missing artifact is reported, never inferred.
